result:
DUX-R-5b-1 is in place: every edit B listed in §1 is done, inside the 11 files I was allowed to change plus the 2 new ones. One brass hover that B's list missed is still there. Nothing has been checked in a browser yet; that is C's part. No commit or push.

**What changed:**
- **Fader thumbs:** the six range sliders (clip gain, Master Volume, track Pan, track Volume, group Volume, Zoom) now use the light neutral colour instead of brass. Their brass focus ring stays.
- **Fade handles:** now hollow — a dark centre with a light border. That keeps them distinct from the envelope points, which are filled light squares.
- **Hover and drag fills:** the clip trim edges, loop edges, track-height handle (hover and drag) and Library resize handle (hover) all use the neutral colour at 50 % strength.
- **Scrollbar thumb:** neutral on hover and while pressed.
- **Collapsed groups:** clip blocks are neutral when not selected. Selected blocks keep the brass.
- **Small cleanup:** two fixed-string `cn()` calls in `ArrangementClip.tsx` are now plain `className` strings.
- **Tests:** two lines in `track-layout.test.tsx` updated to the new class.
- **Docs:** doc 143 marked Completed; new doc 144 in Georgian.
- **One formatting change:** on the group-block line, Biome forced the ternary onto three lines (`ArrangementGroupHeader.tsx` l.354-356). Only formatting changed, not tokens or logic. I flagged it so C doesn't count it as an extra edit.

**Checks I ran:**
- **Targeted tests:** the 13 base files passed 199/199 before the edits; with the new `affordance-colour-ui.test.tsx` (DXA1–DXA7) they pass 206/206.
- **Typecheck, lint, Biome:** typecheck and lint exit cleanly (lint shows only the 218 warnings that were already there); scoped Biome is clean.
- **Mutations:** all 10 required mutations (m248–m257) make the expected tests fail. Each was restored and hash-checked, and I re-ran the whole set against the final files.
- **Scope:** the frozen-file check passes and `git status` shows 11 modified + 2 new files.
- **Code review:** the `code-reviewer` subagent gave 9/10 with nothing blocking. I fixed its Lows and suggestions; its Architecture note is copied word for word into the report for B.

**Open finding for B (A-R175-DETAIL-SEP-ACCENT):** `ArrangementDetailPanel.tsx` l.1121, the height handle of the Clip details panel, still has a brass hover (`hover:bg-accent/60`).
- **Why I didn't change it:** it isn't in any of B's lists, and the task conflicts with itself. §1 says change only the listed tokens, while test DXA7 requires zero of this token in all 9 granted files.
- **What the test does instead:** it pins this one line at exactly one occurrence, so the test fails as soon as someone fixes it.
- **Why it matters:** none of C's browser rows hover this handle, so it will pass this round unnoticed.
- **Suggested fix:** the same neutral 50 % hover, which by B's own numbers gives 4.53:1 against the background. It could be a small follow-up or part of 5b-2. The reviewer rated this gap Medium.

**Not covered by my checks:** jsdom can't show slider thumb colours (`accent-color`) or scrollbar colours, so only C's pixel measurements can confirm them. B's task already plans for one risk: if C finds the thumb below 3:1 against the unfilled part of the slider track, the fallback colour is `accent-muted`.

I passed only the B criteria for my own work (§1, §3.1–§3.3, with the DXA7 pin and the formatting wrap as stated exceptions). I marked no browser row, gate row or backlog item as done.

Everything is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`; open `a-round-175.md` first.
